summary: Electra Battery Materials Corp filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, attaching a press release that welcomes a U.S. Commerce Department rule restricting exports of battery black mass. The rule, issued under the Defense Production Act, requires domestically produced black mass to be sold to U.S. buyers for one year. This is a policy commentary, not a corporate special situation. No transactions, shareholder meetings, or management changes are involved. The filing is routine disclosure of a press release, with no deal terms or strategic actions by the company itself.
